mining_rules.factorization_boundary: Pairs (i,j), i<j, with equal orientation and exactly one negativity equal to 0.0.
mining_rules.marginal_entropy_level: Pairs (i,j), i<j, with equal orientation and exact-unequal entropy_bits.
mining_rules.orientation_winding: Pairs (i,j), i<j, with equal radial_index and unequal orientation.
mining_rules.shell_position: Pairs (i,j), i<j, with equal orientation and unequal radial_index.
mining_rules.source_match: Each mined family is sorted as sorted row-id pairs and exact-matched against the correspondingly normalized S6 edge list.
